title: Pet Feeder 🦴
text: A smart, app-controlled pet feeder built by a cross-functional student team. As cloud team lead, I designed the API and real-time layer connecting the IoT hardware to the mobile app, enabling remote feeding and live status updates.

title: BEUMER Group - Smart Vision 📦
text: My Bachelor's project, in collaboration with BEUMER Group and DPD. I built a real-time computer vision system with YOLOv9 and PyTorch to detect fragile labels on logistics packages, cutting manual handling errors in the sorting process.

title: Blackjack AI ♠️
text: A machine learning model that learns optimal Blackjack strategy. For this semester project I collected and preprocessed game data, then trained and compared several models (from XGBoost to neural networks) to maximize long-term winnings.

title: Pnta 🎉
text: A social app connecting people across Denmark through bars and clubs. I designed and built the microservice backend, integrated it with the manager platform, and designed and implemented the marketing website.

title: Riga Cup ⚽
text: A tournament management platform for the Riga Cup. I led the backend, designing the database, APIs, and authentication that powered team registration and tournament scheduling.
